name: universal-format
description: Silently auto-formats just-written Shell, Java, Kotlin, JS/TS, Python, Go, JSON, YAML and Markdown files after Write/Edit using each language's standard formatter when installed (shfmt, google-java-format/clang-format, ktlint/ktfmt, prettier/biome, ruff/black, goimports/gofmt; prettier also covers JSON/YAML/Markdown, biome also covers JSON; prettier/biome also fall back to npx); honors .editorconfig and tool-native configs; no-op when no formatter is available. Always active once installed — no on/off toggle.
